$comment: Word Assist Phase 1a golden set. ~50 scholarly sentences across the classes the brief requires: citations, numbers, equations/LaTeX, URLs/DOIs, quotes, plain prose, plus RTL/Arabic and CJK and emoji cases. For every 'protected' sentence the engine must produce zero edits inside the protected content (Tier 1 must return it unchanged after validation); 'plain' sentences carry the grammar/style expectations the unit tests assert. This file is data for tests/assist_golden.rs, never compiled.
